name: Video Lab
description: A seven-phase workflow for studying source footage and producing a verified recreation package.

phases.name: Intake + Goal
phases.prompt: Define the requested video outcome, constraints, source assets, done criteria, and ownership. Stop for unresolved scope conflicts.

phases.name: Visual Teardown
phases.prompt: Inspect supplied footage natively. Post an ordered visual timeline, motion behavior, composition, and any evidence limits.

phases.name: Evidence + Decomposition
phases.prompt: Find the real source assets or template when possible. Post paths, timestamps, interaction evidence, and a build-ready decomposition.

phases.name: Recreation Decision
phases.prompt: Choose reuse, live capture, or recreation from the evidence. State the smallest approved implementation slice and acceptance checks.

phases.name: Production Package
phases.prompt: Create only the approved production assets. Post changed files, commands, validation, and any blocker for integration.

phases.name: Integrate + QC
phases.prompt: Integrate the package, run focused quality checks, and verify timing, visual fidelity, and output format. Report evidence or blockers.

phases.name: Release
phases.prompt: Audit the result against the goal and release criteria. Post final artifact evidence or the concrete reason release is blocked.
